title: Three of a kind? Xi hosts Trump and Putin as Ukraine war grinds on
summary: Gang of three or glorified photo op? Xi Jinping hosting Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of the APEC summit. Already, our Monday panel rejected attempts to paint the three-way meeting as a new Yalta, as in the 1945 sit-down on the Black Sea that defined the post-war security architecture of Europe.
